Task: Authenticate and authorize every read and mutation

Task: Restrict price-provider navigation
Acceptance criterion: Internal addresses and redirect/subrequest bypasses are rejected; expensive requests are bounded

Task: Validate uploaded file content and limits
Acceptance criterion: Invalid file fields, forged MIME, HTML extensions and oversized files fail before storage

Task: Migrate ebooks to private durable storage
Acceptance criterion: Only authorized readers obtain attachment access; replacement and deletion clean up storage

Task: Upgrade affected dependencies deliberately
Acceptance criterion: Compatible patched stack passes build and reader checks; remaining advisories have reviewed dispositions

Task: Restrict or move Google Books credential
Acceptance criterion: API and origin restrictions verified; any secret credential stays server-side; unrestricted key rotated

Task: Repair manual add and metadata editing
Acceptance criterion: Manual title and author entry works and survives reload; blank identity is rejected

Task: Persist explicit copy deletion or archive
Acceptance criterion: Deleted copy stays absent after reload; unselected and unloaded copies remain intact

Task: Persist reading dates and completion history
Acceptance criterion: Start and completion dates survive reload and update goal/history statistics

Task: Complete lend return renew and due-date flows
Acceptance criterion: Lend and return survive reload; active loan and history are shown consistently

Task: Use canonical shelf location in editor
Acceptance criterion: Changing a nonempty shelf location persists the new location

Task: Connect physical reading timer
Acceptance criterion: Timer is reachable and session time and pages persist

Task: Separate complete-library operations from listing state
Acceptance criterion: Analytics loans wishlist export duplicate lookup and facets include records beyond the loaded page

Task: Patch selected work and protect concurrent history
Acceptance criterion: Editing a later copy updates its shared Work; independent session appends are not lost

Task: Await mutations and recover from save failure
Acceptance criterion: Failed save keeps draft or rolls back; success appears after commit; repeated submit is blocked

Task: Unify filter sort and ownership contracts
Acceptance criterion: Every desktop/mobile filter value is implemented; price/year ordering and exact volume filters are correct

Task: Fix cursor pagination and URL restoration
Acceptance criterion: No repeated first-page request or stale-filter append; reload and history behavior is defined

Task: Persist EPUB CFI and attachment media type
Acceptance criterion: EPUB returns to last location; signed URLs and uppercase filenames select the correct reader

Task: Implement complete idempotent import/export round-trip

Task: Separate offers from costs and close scraper browsers

Task: Tie enrichment to book request and editor draft

Task: Resolve share-card covers consistently
Acceptance criterion: Remote/local/fallback covers render and download; failures are visible

Task: Correct activity goals and Wrapped metrics
Acceptance criterion: Activity includes today; active days are unique; measured minutes and imported completions are counted

Task: Use real progress and durable active-time recording
Acceptance criterion: Wishlist labels remain accurate; progress does not advance while idle; reader progress survives interruption

Task: Move pagination filtering and sorting into database
Acceptance criterion: Normal listing retrieves a bounded page; numeric years and stable ordering are indexed based on query plans

Task: Replace all-loaded-row saves with focused mutations
Acceptance criterion: One edit updates its intended record only; large imports run in bounded idempotent batches

Task: Preaggregate activity and share pure selectors

Task: Evolve edition ownership money and history models
Acceptance criterion: Migration preserves data; ownership/reading/lending remain independent; money/date fields are typed

Task: Validate boundaries and expose retryable error states

Task: Fix lint and isolate side effects and component responsibilities
